# Connector review

Review independently of the author. Confirm that the change satisfies the linked intent, design, and acceptance criteria. Check client isolation, access control, tool scope, secret handling, and error paths when they are affected. Examine the verification evidence and flag meaningful gaps before approval. Review changes to prompts, skills, tools, and evaluation cases together.

A repository collaborator approves the final PR head. An Oracle operator separately authorizes the merged release SHA after regression and live-agent CI succeed.
